blocks.text: Quantum theory do baatein maanti hai: (1) electromagnetic radiation (jaise roshni) energy ke chhote chhote alag packets mein hoti hai, aur (2) bohat chhote scale (paimane) par particles bhi waves ki tarah behave karte hain. Yeh shayad physics ki sab se kamyab theory hai: jo masle pehle hal nahi ho rahe the, yeh un ki explanation (wazahat) deti hai aur bilkul sahi predictions (pehle se batana) deti hai.
Lekin rozana zindagi ke aam kaamon (bari cheezon) ke liye classical physics (Newton wali physics) ab bhi sahi kaam karti hai. Is chapter mein hum quantum theory ke alag alag aspects (pehlu) parhenge.

blocks.prompt: Quantum effects (asraat) kahan ahem hain, aur classical physics kahan ab bhi theek kaam karti hai?
blocks.explanation: Quantum effects atom jitni chhoti cheezon aur un se takrane wali radiation ke liye ahem hain. Rozana ki bari cheezon (gend, gaari, spring) ke liye classical physics theek kaam karti hai.

items: Quantum theory: radiation energy ke packets (quanta) mein; chhote particles waves jaise.
Rozana ki bari cheezon ke liye classical physics ab bhi sahi.
